run_preprocess_binarize: run the preprocess CLI to build vocabularies and binarize training data for source and target languages
run_preprocess_joined_dict: run the preprocess CLI with --joined-dictionary to generate a shared dictionary for source and target languages
run_preprocess_align: run the preprocess CLI with --alignfile to produce a word alignment dictionary from alignment data
run_preprocess_raw: run the preprocess CLI with --output-format raw to copy original text files instead of binarizing
run_preprocess_only_source: run the preprocess CLI with --only-source to process only the source language without a target
